# A component's method calls another through `this` as it calls one bare, on
# every target. testdata/own_receiver_call.txtar is the code.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component counter ui.node {
    var hits = 0

    func add(by int) {
        hits += by
    }

    func twice() {
        this.add(1)
        add(2)
    }

    ui.button #b(text="{hits}", @click {
        twice()
    })
}

func testThroughThis(t Test, c counter) {
    c.b.click()
    t.assert(c.hits == 3)
}

ui.window {
    counter()
}
